page.notes: The index is in three columns, read column by column. Several lines in the left and middle columns are partly illegible in the scan (for example the Vota monastica and Vniversalem entries and some numbers), and the blank cells above are where the scan could not be read reliably. Entries printed with the old long-s and ligature forms are given with plain s. The red stamp of the Bibliothèque de la Ville de Lyon is not transcribed.
